deep.reconstruction: There is no mathematics on this folio. Folio 161v is a printed page, numbered 14, from a German antiquarian bookseller's sale catalogue, section 'Naturwissenschaft und Physik'. It holds an alphabetical list of entries running from Ule, O. ('die Natur') to Winterl, J. J. ('Darst. d. 4 Bestandth. d. anorgan. Nat.'). Each entry gives author, short title, format (8., 4., Fol.), place and year (year in abbreviated form, e.g. '851' = 1851), binding (Ppbd., Hlbfzbd., br., cart., etc.), an optional original price in parentheses, and the sale price in Thaler and Silbergroschen. The previous and next folios are pages of the same catalogue (p. 13, and a page containing gardening and 'Astronomie'). Nothing handwritten by Riemann is visible on this page: no marginalia, calculations or underlinings. Presumably the sheet survives in the bundle as scrap paper or a wrapper, or because Riemann kept the catalogue. There is no derivation to reconstruct, and no problem is being served.
deep.surprise_reason: The page is a printed bookseller's catalogue of natural-science titles with no handwriting or mathematics by Riemann. At most it hints that Riemann had such catalogues at hand, which is unremarkable.
transcription_corrections: The currency sign rendered as '₰' (Pfennig) is actually the Thaler sign. For example, '1 ₰ 25 Sgr.' means 1 Thaler 25 Silbergroschen. The parenthesized values are original or list prices in Thaler.
Wezel entry: the printed word (hyphenated across the line) should read 'So-matologie' (Somatologie), not 'Sa-matologie'.
The 'Wildenow, C. L.' spelling follows the print; the botanist's name is normally spelled Willdenow.
Vahl entry: the date is printed '805/6' (1805–06), transcribed as '805.6.'.
The page header is printed '14 Naturwissenschaft und Physik.'. The page number '45' in the next-page transcription is probably a misreading of '15' and does not concern this page.
